events_detected.title: US Treasury coordinated yen intervention with Japan - first since 1998
events_detected.description: US Treasury and Japan Finance Ministry conducted rare coordinated yen-buying intervention Jul 31/Aug 1. Record 8.45T yen intervention + 5.33T follow-up. First joint US-Japan FX intervention since 1998. Asahi warns of perfect storm: extreme yen weakness, JGB stress, Treasury curve stress, credibility issues at Fed and BOJ.
events_detected.update: Asahi analysis warns of perfect storm. BOJ published JGB reduction impact study Aug 4. Total intervention ~13.78T yen confirmed.

events_detected.title: DRC Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak - largest ever, WORSENING. 3,874 cases, 1,751 deaths
